self_critique:
Run critique

The “converged” stop is premature. Only three sibling ideas were tested, all derived from the same overfitting diagnosis, with no follow-up on the sole numerically promising result.

Suboptimal harness/policy behavior:
- node_001 scored 0.6027 versus the 0.601838 baseline yet was rejected. The journal should record the exact rejection criterion, unrounded scores, uncertainty, and seed/replicate results. Without that, the decision is not auditable.
- node_001 bundled four interventions—interaction dropout, accessed-row L2, AdamW decay, and LR milestones—so even a confirmed gain would not identify the useful component.
- No replication was used to distinguish small improvements from seed noise. This is essential when expected gains are around 0.001.
- The policy abandoned promising regularization after one bundled trial rather than decomposing or tuning it.
- BPR weight and recency half-life were arbitrary one-shot settings. Their failures reject those configurations, not the broader ideas.
- The search remained narrow: no optimizer/LR sweep, embedding dimension or feature-interaction changes, calibration/objective weighting, checkpoint averaging, or explicit early-stopping study.
- All hypotheses leaned on “peak at epoch 8 then decline,” but the scaffold did not first verify whether selecting/checkpointing by validation primary already captures that peak.

Scaffold changes:
- Require paired multi-seed evaluation for candidates within roughly 0.002 of baseline, using confidence intervals or a predefined practical-significance threshold.
- Preserve “promising but uncertain” candidates instead of treating them as hard rejections.
- Generate atomic experiments first; only combine interventions after identifying individual contributors.
- Add a follow-up policy: any candidate with a positive raw delta gets replication or ablation before convergence.
- Record rejection reasons and full-precision metrics.
- Require broader hypothesis coverage before declaring convergence.

Next run:
First, reproduce node_001 across several matched seeds. If the gain persists, ablate its components, starting with LR decay/earlier checkpointing and AdamW weight decay separately. This is the strongest existing signal and is more justified than immediately trying another objective or temporal weighting scheme.
